text:
I need to find information about Wolf Mankowitz's 1953 novel title "A Kid For Two..."

Let me search for this information.

<bash>
curl -s "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wolf_Mankowitz" | grep -i "kid for two" | head -5
</bash>

<bash>
curl -s "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wolf_Mankowitz" | grep -i "1953" | head -10
</bash>

<bash>
# Let me try a more general search
curl -s "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wolf_Mankowitz" > /tmp/mankowitz.html
grep -i "kid" /tmp/mankowitz.html | head -10
</bash>

<bash>
# Search for the complete title
grep -i "farthing" /tmp
